title.zh: 武则天被立为皇后

summary.zh: 高宗废王皇后、萧淑妃为庶人，立武则天为皇后。武则天在争宠中设计陷害王皇后（据《资治通鉴》，武则天杀死自己的女儿嫁祸王皇后），并以“厌胜”罪名指控王皇后和萧淑妃。以长孙无忌、褚遂良为首的元老派坚决反对，但高宗最终采纳李勣“此陛下家事”的意见，下诏立武氏为后。王皇后和萧淑妃随后被杀害。武则天成为皇后后迅速干预朝政，形成了“二圣”格局。

statement.zh: 高宗废王皇后、萧淑妃为庶人，立武则天为皇后。武则天在争宠中设计陷害王皇后（据《资治通鉴》，武则天杀死自己的女儿嫁祸王皇后），并以“厌胜”罪名指控王皇后和萧淑妃。以长孙无忌、褚遂良为首的元老派坚决反对，但高宗最终采纳李勣“此陛下家事”的意见，下诏立武氏为后。王皇后和萧淑妃随后被杀害。武则天成为皇后后迅速干预朝政，形成了“二圣”格局。
statement.en:
Gaozong deposed Empress Wang and Consort Xiao as commoners and made Wu Zetian empress. In the power struggle, Wu had plotted against Wang (according to the 'Zizhi Tongjian', she killed her own daughter and blamed Wang). She also accused Wang and Xiao of practicing witchcraft. The senior statesmen led by Changsun Wuji and Chu Suiliang strongly opposed, but Gaozong accepted Li Ji's remark that 'this is your majesty's family affair' and issued an edict making Wu empress. Empress Wang and Consort Xiao were later killed. After becoming empress, Wu quickly began interfering in affairs of state, forming a 'Two Saints' power structure.

For Asia in 655 CE, “Wu Zetian is made empress” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 阿拉伯军队首次进攻君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 哈里发奥斯曼命叙利亚总督穆阿维叶率海军舰队和陆军联合进攻拜占庭首都君士坦丁堡。阿拉伯舰队从叙利亚出发，沿小亚细亚海岸北上，但遭遇拜占庭海军“希腊火”的首次大规模使用，舰队损失惨重。陆路方面，阿拉伯军被拜占庭坚固的城墙和寒冷冬季所阻，被迫撤退。这是阿拉伯帝国对君士坦丁堡的第一次重大攻势，虽然失败，但预示着未来数百年的持续威胁。

title.zh: 高宗改元显庆，武则天开始参政

summary.zh: 唐高宗改年号为显庆，武则天以皇后身份开始参与朝廷决策。长孙无忌、褚遂良等元老相继被贬逐。武则天借高宗体弱多病之机，逐步培养自己的政治班底（如许敬宗、李义府）。显庆年间形成了“帝后同朝”的局面，武则天事实上成为第二位皇帝，为日后称帝铺垫道路。

title.zh: 第三任哈里发奥斯曼遇刺

summary.zh: 因奥斯曼任人唯亲、腐败盛行，且强行统一《古兰经》版本焚烧异本，引发各地穆斯林（特别是埃及和库法的反对派）强烈不满。五百名反叛者包围奥斯曼在麦地那的住宅，最终将他乱刀砍死。奥斯曼之死标志着正统哈里发时期的结束，导致了穆斯林内部的第一次大分裂。阿里被拥立为第四任哈里发，但叙利亚总督穆阿维叶拒绝承认，伊斯兰教第一次内战（绥芬之战）爆发，逊尼派与什叶派正式分裂。

title.zh: 阿里成为第四任哈里发

summary.zh: 奥斯曼遇刺后，麦地那的穆斯林推举阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜（穆罕默德的堂弟和女婿）为第四任正统哈里发。阿里试图削弱叙利亚总督穆阿维叶的权力，但穆阿维叶拒绝臣服，要求惩办杀害奥斯曼的凶手。双方在绥芬平原对峙，谈判破裂后爆发内战。伊斯兰教因此分裂为拥护阿里的什叶派（“什叶”意为党派）和多数派逊尼派。

title.zh: 唐灭西突厥

summary.zh: 苏定方被任命为伊丽道行军大总管，率军一万精骑及回纥等部骑兵远征阿史那贺鲁。苏定方在伊丽水（今伊犁河）和碎叶水（今楚河）大败贺鲁，追至石国（今乌兹别克斯坦塔什干），石国将贺鲁缚送唐军。西突厥汗国彻底灭亡。唐朝在其地设昆陵都护府和濛池都护府，分封十姓部落首领为都督。唐朝疆域向西达到咸海，与波斯、阿拉伯接壤。

statement.zh: 苏定方被任命为伊丽道行军大总管，率军一万精骑及回纥等部骑兵远征阿史那贺鲁。苏定方在伊丽水（今伊犁河）和碎叶水（今楚河）大败贺鲁，追至石国（今乌兹别克斯坦塔什干），石国将贺鲁缚送唐军。西突厥汗国彻底灭亡。唐朝在其地设昆陵都护府和濛池都护府，分封十姓部落首领为都督。唐朝疆域向西达到咸海，与波斯、阿拉伯接壤。
statement.en:
Su Dingfang was appointed commander for the Ili route (Yili Dao). He led 10,000 elite cavalry along with Uyghur and other allied horse archers against Ashina Helu. Su Dingfang defeated Helu at the Ili River and the Chu River (Suyab), pursuing him to Tashkent (Shiguo), where the lord of Tashkent captured Helu and sent him to the Tang camp. The Western Turkic Khaganate was completely destroyed. The Tang established the Kunling and Mengchi Protectorates on its territory, appointing the ten tribal leaders as governors (duhu). The Tang western frontier extended to the Aral Sea, bordering Persia and the Arab Empire.

For Asia in 657 CE, “Tang destroys the Western Turks” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 安西都护府迁至龟兹

summary.zh: 唐朝将安西都护府治所从西州迁往龟兹（今新疆库车），正式确立安西四镇（龟兹、疏勒、于阗、焉耆）的防御体系。安西都护府统辖天山南路、葱岭、河中地区，成为唐朝经营西域的政治军事中心，也是丝绸之路的重要安全保障。

title.zh: 唐朝安西都护府进一步向西扩张

summary.zh: 唐朝在灭西突厥后，继续向西经营。安西都护府辖境扩展到葱岭以西（今帕米尔高原以西），包括昭武九姓诸国（康国、安国、石国等）。唐朝在这些地区设立羁縻州府，任命当地国王为都督。唐朝的势力范围最远到达波斯东境，与阿拉伯帝国直接对峙。

title.zh: 长孙无忌被贬，高宗彻底集权

summary.zh: 武则天与许敬宗等合谋诬陷长孙无忌谋反，唐高宗流放长孙无忌至黔州，不久许敬宗又逼其自杀。长孙无忌是太宗托孤元老，他的倒台标志着关陇贵族集团势力彻底崩溃，高宗和武则天完全掌控朝政。此后，武则天提拔庶族和寒门士人，官僚体系发生深刻变化。

statement.zh: 武则天与许敬宗等合谋诬陷长孙无忌谋反，唐高宗流放长孙无忌至黔州，不久许敬宗又逼其自杀。长孙无忌是太宗托孤元老，他的倒台标志着关陇贵族集团势力彻底崩溃，高宗和武则天完全掌控朝政。此后，武则天提拔庶族和寒门士人，官僚体系发生深刻变化。
statement.en:
Wu Zetian and Xu Jingzong conspired to fabricate a rebellion charge against Changsun Wuji. Emperor Gaozong exiled Changsun Wuji to Qianzhou, and soon after Xu Jingzong forced him to commit suicide. Changsun Wuji, the senior minister entrusted by Taizong, fell, marking the complete collapse of the Guanlong aristocratic group, and Gaozong and Wu Zetian gained full control of the court. Afterward, Wu promoted commoner scholars and those from humble backgrounds, leading to profound changes in the bureaucracy.

For Asia in 659 CE, “Changsun Wuji is exiled; Gaozong centralizes power” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 659年，唐代官修《新修本草》（又称《唐本草》）颁行，收药八百余种，为世界第一部由国家颁定的药典，标志药物学纳入国家规制。
statement.en: In 659 the Tang court issues the Newly Revised Materia Medica (Tang Ben Cao), listing over eight hundred drugs — the world’s first pharmacopeia promulgated by a state, bringing pharmacology under state regulation.

title.zh: 苏定方灭百济

summary.zh: 应新罗请求，唐高宗命苏定方率十万水陆大军征讨百济。苏定方从成山（山东荣成）渡海，在白江口（锦江口）登陆，击败百济军，包围其都城泗沘。百济义慈王出降，百济灭亡。唐朝在百济故地设熊津、马韩、东明等五都督府，由当地酋长担任都督。百济遗臣鬼室福信后来复国，并请求日本援助，导致663年白江口之战。

title.zh: 唐朝应新罗之请，共同征讨高句丽

title.zh: 倭马亚王朝建立，定都大马士革

summary.zh: 阿里在库法被刺杀后，穆阿维叶击败阿里的继任者哈桑，成为唯一的哈里发，建立倭马亚王朝（伍麦叶王朝）。他定都大马士革，将选举制改为世袭君主制。穆阿维叶推行阿拉伯化政策：发行统一金币第纳尔，将阿拉伯语定为官方语言，建立邮政系统和官僚机构。倭马亚王朝从西班牙扩张到中亚，成为当时世界上疆域最广的帝国之一。

statement.en: After Ali was assassinated at Kufa, Mu'awiya defeated Ali's successor Hasan and became the sole caliph, founding the Umayyad Caliphate.

en: After Ali was assassinated at Kufa, Mu'awiya defeated Ali's successor Hasan and became the sole caliph, founding the Umayyad Caliphate.

title.zh: 白江口海战，唐军大败倭国·百济联军

summary.zh: 唐将刘仁轨率水军七千、战船一百七十艘，在白江口（今韩国锦江口）迎战倭国（日本）水军。倭军有战船四百余艘、兵三万余人。刘仁轨利用唐船高大坚固和火攻优势，分四路围攻倭军。倭军船只拥挤不堪，被唐军火攻焚烧殆尽，海水皆赤。白江口之战是中国古代水战史上著名战例，彻底粉碎了日本干预朝鲜半岛的野心，确立了唐朝在东北亚的霸权。此后日本全面臣服，并加紧派遣遣唐使学习唐朝制度。

statement.en: Tang admiral Liu Rengui led 7,000 marines and 170 warships into battle at the Baekgang River (Geum River estuary) against the Japanese (Wa) fleet.

title.zh: 玄奘圆寂

summary.zh: 玄奘法师在长安玉华寺圆寂，享年六十三岁。唐高宗哀恸，下令五天不上朝，丧葬费用由朝廷承担。玄奘葬于白鹿原，后迁葬少陵原。他译经七十五部、一千三百三十五卷，撰《大唐西域记》，开创法相宗。玄奘的求法精神成为中印文化交流的象征，对中国佛教发展产生了不可估量的影响。

statement.zh: 玄奘法师在长安玉华寺圆寂，享年63岁。唐高宗哀恸，下令五天不上朝，丧葬费用由朝廷承担。玄奘葬于白鹿原，后迁葬少陵原。他译经七十五部、一千三百三十五卷，撰《大唐西域记》，开创法相宗。玄奘的求法精神成为中印文化交流的象征，对中国佛教发展产生了不可估量的影响。
statement.en:
The monk Xuanzang died in the Jade Flower Temple in Chang'an at the age of 63. Emperor Gaozong, deeply saddened, ordered the suspension of court for five days and that the burial expenses be borne by the state. Xuanzang was buried at White Deer Plain, later moved to Shaoling Plain. He had translated 75 texts in 1,335 volumes, written the 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions', and founded the Faxiang (Yogācāra) school. Xuanzang's spirit of seeking the Dharma became a symbol of Sino-Indian cultural exchange and had an incalculable impact on the development of Chinese Buddhism.

For Asia in 664 CE, “Xuanzang passes away” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

Xuanzang was buried at White Deer Plain, later moved to Shaoling Plain. He had translated 75 texts in 1,335 volumes, written the 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions', and founded the Faxiang (Yogācāra) school. Xuanzang's spirit of seeking the Dharma became a symbol of Sino-Indian cultural exchange and had an incalculable impact on the development of Chinese Buddhism.

title.zh: 唐高宗部署再次征伐高句丽

title.zh: 唐高宗泰山封禅

summary.zh: 唐高宗李治效仿秦始皇、汉武帝，率文武百官和各国使节前往泰山举行封禅大典。封禅是帝王在泰山祭祀天地、宣告受命于天的最高礼仪。高宗先祭天于封坛，再祭地于禅坛，武则天以皇后身份亚献（这在历史上是首次）。封禅耗费巨大，但显示了唐朝国力强盛和四夷宾服的盛世景象。

statement.zh: 唐高宗李治效仿秦始皇、汉武帝，率文武百官和各国使节前往泰山举行封禅大典。封禅是帝王在泰山祭祀天地、宣告受命于天的最高礼仪。高宗先祭天于封坛，再祭地于禅坛，武则天以皇后身份亚献（这在历史上是首次）。封禅耗费巨大，但显示了唐朝国力强盛和四夷宾服的盛世景象。
statement.en:
Emperor Gaozong of Tang, following the examples of the First Emperor of Qin and Emperor Wu of Han, led a large entourage of officials and foreign envoys to Mount Tai to perform the Fengshan ceremony. Fengshan was the highest imperial ritual of sacrificing to heaven and earth at Mount Tai, announcing that the emperor had received the Mandate of Heaven. Gaozong first offered sacrifice to heaven on the sealing altar, then to earth on the revetment altar. Empress Wu Zetian, as empress, performed the second sacrifice (the first time in history). The ceremony was extremely costly but demonstrated the prosperity of the Tang and the homage of the Four Directions.

For Asia in 666 CE, “Emperor Gaozong of Tang conducts a Fengshan sacrifice at Mount Tai” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 日本天智天皇即位

summary.zh: 日本中大兄皇子在齐明天皇去世后即位，是为天智天皇。他继续推行大化改新的各项政策，颁行《近江令》（日本第一部成文法典），完善官僚制度和户籍制度，并修订《庚午年籍》。天智天皇还主导编修了日本第一部史书《日本书纪》（成书于720年）。他的统治标志着日本律令国家的进一步巩固。

sources.locator: Opening paragraph and section on accession
sources.excerpt: Tenji (born 625/626, Japan—died Jan. 7, 672, Ōtsu, Ōmi province) was the 38th emperor of Japan, from 668 to 672, and the ruler who freed the Japanese court from the domination of the Soga family. Tenji implemented a series of reforms that strengthened the central government in accord with the Chinese model and restored power to the emperor. ... In 662 Nakano Ōe became emperor, although he was not officially enthroned until 668.

title.zh: 统一新罗：先借唐，再逐唐

summary.zh: 660年，新罗与唐的联军灭百济；668年，联军又灭高句丽。新罗由此统一朝鲜半岛三国故地，这是历史时期朝鲜半岛第一次由本土领导层完成统一。此后近十年，新罗与唐继续交战，最终把唐军逐出。

statement.zh: 新罗与唐结盟，660年灭百济、668年灭高句丽；新罗由此统一朝鲜半岛三国故地，这是历史时期朝鲜半岛第一次由本土领导层完成统一。
statement.en: Silla allied with Tang, destroyed Baekje in 660 and Goguryeo in 668; it thus unified the former territories of the three kingdoms, the first occasion in historical times that the Korean peninsula was unified under indigenous leadership.

sources.locator: 首段，Silla–Tang alliance 与 660/668 句
sources.excerpt: The old Silla kingdom had forged an alliance with T’ang China (618–907) and had conquered the kingdom of Paekche to the southeast in 660 and the northern Korean kingdom of Koguryŏ—largest of the three—in 668.

sources.locator: 第二段，first occasion 句
sources.excerpt: This was the first occasion within historical times that the Korean peninsula had been unified under indigenous leadership.

zh: 660年，新罗与唐的联军灭百济；668年，联军又灭高句丽。新罗由此统一朝鲜半岛三国故地，这是历史时期朝鲜半岛第一次由本土领导层完成统一
en: In 660 the allied forces of Silla and Tang destroyed Baekje; in 668 they destroyed Goguryeo. Silla thus unified the former territories of the three kingdoms, the first occasion in historical times that the Korean peninsula was unified under indigenous leadership

statement.zh: 统一后近十年，新罗与唐继续交战，最终把唐军逐出。
statement.en: For nearly a decade after 668, Silla fought Tang and finally expelled Tang's forces.

sources.locator: 第二段，fighting and expulsion 句
sources.excerpt: For nearly a decade after 668, fighting ensued in which Silla finally expelled T’ang forces.

zh: 此后近十年，新罗与唐继续交战，最终把唐军逐出
en: For nearly a decade afterwards Silla fought Tang and finally expelled its forces

statement.zh: 新罗按中国官僚模式设部与官署、划九个行政区、并在各地驻军，但旧贵族仍掌权。
statement.en: Silla reorganised on the Chinese bureaucratic model with ministries, nine administrative provinces and garrisons, but the old aristocracy remained in control.

sources.locator: 第三段，administrative reorganisation 句
sources.excerpt: After the unification, the country was reorganized in accord with the Chinese bureaucratic model. A complex system of ministries and bureaus was created; the peninsula was divided into nine provinces, which were in turn divided into prefectures and subprefectures; and military garrisons were established throughout the country. But a bureaucratic class based on merit, as in China, was never firmly established, and the old aristocracy remained firmly in control.

zh: 统一后的国家按中国官僚模式重组：设部与官署，把半岛划分为九个行政区，并在各地驻军；但以功绩为基础的官僚层并未稳固建立，旧贵族仍然掌权
en: After unification the country was reorganised on the Chinese bureaucratic model: ministries and bureaus were created, the peninsula was divided into nine administrative provinces, and garrisons were stationed across the country. Yet a bureaucracy based on merit was never firmly established, and the old aristocracy remained in control

statement.zh: 统一不是终点，而是重新定义“谁说了算”的过程：新罗借唐军消灭对手，再以战争赶走唐军，最后把统一叙事写成自己的。
statement.en: Unification was not an endpoint but a redefinition of who held power: Silla used Tang's armies to destroy its rivals, fought Tang's garrisons out, and wrote the unification narrative as its own.

zh: 统一不是终点，而是一次重新定义“谁说了算”的过程：新罗借唐的军队消灭对手，又用战争把唐的驻军赶走，最后把统一叙事写成了自己的
en: Unification was not an endpoint but a redefinition of who held power: Silla used Tang's armies to destroy its rivals, then fought Tang's garrisons out, and finally wrote the unification narrative as its own

title.zh: 唐朝大规模迁移高句丽遗民

summary.zh: 为防止高句丽遗民复国，唐朝将高句丽贵族和平民约数十万人分批迁往江淮、中原和巴蜀地区。高句丽王族被授予官职，散居长安等地。这次迁移有效地瓦解了高句丽的民族凝聚力，但也导致高句丽文化和历史记录的大规模消失。

title.zh: 突厥汗国在中亚的文化影响

summary.zh: 第二东突厥汗国（后突厥）统治中亚时期，突厥文化吸收了波斯和粟特元素，创造了突厥如尼文（鄂尔浑-叶尼塞文），并树立了著名的《阙特勤碑》和《毗伽可汗碑》。这些碑刻用突厥如尼文和汉文书写，记录了突厥历史、英雄故事和与唐朝的互动，是研究古代突厥语言和历史的珍贵文物。

statement.zh: 第二东突厥汗国（后突厥）统治中亚时期，突厥文化吸收了波斯和粟特元素，创造了突厥如尼文（鄂尔浑-叶尼塞文），并树立了著名的《阙特勤碑》和《毗伽可汗碑》。
statement.en: During its rule over Central Asia, the Second Eastern Turkic Khaganate (or later Türkic Khaganate) absorbed Persian and Sogdian elements, created the Old Turkic runic script (Orkhon-Yenisei script), and erected the famous 'Kul Tigin Stele' and 'Bilge Khagan Stele'.

title.zh: 大非川之战，唐军惨败于吐蕃

summary.zh: 吐蕃大论（大相）论钦陵率四十万大军进攻吐谷浑。唐朝派薛仁贵为逻娑道行军大总管，率五万唐军迎战。薛仁贵先轻骑突袭，击败吐蕃于大非川（今青海共和西南），但副将郭待封不遵将令，辎重被吐蕃劫掠。唐军粮尽退兵，在大非川遭遇吐蕃主力围击，全军覆没。薛仁贵被迫与吐蕃约和而归。大非川之战是唐朝开国以来最大的军事失败之一，吐蕃从此与唐朝在河陇地区形成对峙。

statement.zh: 吐蕃大论（大相）论钦陵率四十万大军进攻吐谷浑。唐朝派薛仁贵为逻娑道行军大总管，率五万唐军迎战。薛仁贵先轻骑突袭，击败吐蕃于大非川（今青海共和西南），但副将郭待封不遵将令，辎重被吐蕃劫掠。唐军粮尽退兵，在大非川遭遇吐蕃主力围击，全军覆没。薛仁贵被迫与吐蕃约和而归。大非川之战是唐朝开国以来最大的军事失败之一，吐蕃从此与唐朝在河陇地区形成对峙。
statement.en:
Tibetan lönchen Gar Trinring (also known as Mgar Khri-'bring) led 400,000 troops to attack the Tuyuhun. The Tang sent Xue Rengui as commander-in-chief of the Lhasa route (Luo suo dao) with 50,000 troops. Xue Rengui first launched a cavalry raid, defeating the Tibetans at Dafeichuan (southwest of present-day Gonghe, Qinghai). However, his deputy Guo Daifeng disobeyed orders, and his supply train was captured by the Tibetans. The Tang army, out of food, retreated and was surrounded at Dafeichuan by the main Tibetan force, resulting in total annihilation. Xue Rengui was forced to conclude a peace and return. The Battle of Dafeichuan was one of the greatest military defeats for the Tang since its founding, and thereafter the Tibetans faced the Tang along the Hexi Corridor in a standoff.

For Asia in 670 CE, “Battle of Dafeichuan: Tang army suffers a disastrous defeat by Tibet” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 耶路撒冷圆顶清真寺建成

summary.zh: 倭马亚王朝哈里发阿卜杜勒·马利克在耶路撒冷圣殿山（犹太人称为圣殿山，穆斯林称为尊贵禁地）建造了岩石圆顶清真寺。该建筑呈八角形，中央巨大的岩石相传是穆罕默德登霄之处，也是亚伯拉罕献祭以撒之处。圆顶外部覆盖黄金，内部有精美马赛克。岩石圆顶清真寺成为伊斯兰教仅次于麦加克尔白和麦地那先知清真寺的第三圣地，也是耶路撒冷的地标。

title.zh: 阿拉伯帝国首次围攻君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 倭马亚哈里发穆阿维叶派大将雅齐德率陆军和海陆军再次围攻君士坦丁堡。阿拉伯舰队封锁了博斯普鲁斯海峡，陆上攻势持续数年。拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁四世利用希腊火和坚固城墙坚守。这次围攻直到678年才解除，是阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡最危险的一次攻击。

statement.zh: 倭马亚哈里发穆阿维叶派大将雅齐德率陆军和海陆军再次围攻君士坦丁堡。阿拉伯舰队封锁了博斯普鲁斯海峡，陆上攻势持续数年。拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁四世利用希腊火和坚固城墙坚守。这次围攻直到678年才解除，是阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡最危险的一次攻击。
statement.en:
Umayyad Caliph Mu'awiya sent his son Yazid with land and naval forces to besiege Constantinople. The Arab fleet blockaded the Bosphorus, and the land assault continued for several years. Byzantine Emperor Constantine IV used Greek fire and the city's massive walls to hold out. The siege continued until 678, when it was finally lifted. This was one of the most dangerous Arab attacks on Constantinople.

For Europe in 670 CE, “First Arab siege of Constantinople” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 希腊火击退阿拉伯舰队

summary.zh: 拜占庭海军在君士坦丁堡海战中大规模使用希腊火（一种海上液态燃烧剂，以石油、硫磺等制成，遇水燃烧）。阿拉伯舰队被希腊火重创，损失大量舰船。希腊火的成功使用帮助拜占庭守住了首都，并迫使阿拉伯人撤军。这是希腊火在历史上最著名的战例。

statement.en: The Byzantine navy used Greek fire (a liquid incendiary compound of petroleum, sulfur, and other ingredients that burns on water) on a large scale in the naval battle before Constantinople.

title.zh: 武则天称天后，形成“二圣临朝”

title.zh: 倭马亚王朝进行货币改革

summary.zh: 哈里发阿卜杜勒·马利克推行货币改革，废除拜占庭和波斯钱币，铸造伊斯兰金币第纳尔（纯金4.25克）和银币迪尔汗。钱币上不再使用国王头像，而是用《古兰经》经文装饰。这次改革统一了阿拉伯帝国的货币体系，促进了内部贸易和经济繁荣，也标志着阿拉伯帝国在文化上与拜占庭、波斯彻底分离。

statement.en: Caliph Abd al-Malik introduced monetary reform, abolishing Byzantine and Persian coins and minting the gold dinar (4.25g pure gold) and silver dirham.

title.zh: 唐朝将安东都护府内迁至辽东

summary.zh: 由于新罗势力扩张和唐军力量不足，唐朝将安东都护府从平壤内迁至辽东城（今辽阳），后又迁至幽州（北京）。这标志着唐朝放弃了直接控制朝鲜半岛北部，新罗实际上占领了大同江以南的地区。唐朝与新罗维持了宗藩关系，但不再进行军事对抗。

statement.zh: 由于新罗势力扩张和唐军力量不足，唐朝将安东都护府从平壤内迁至辽东城（今辽阳），后又迁至幽州（北京）。这标志着唐朝放弃了直接控制朝鲜半岛北部，新罗实际上占领了大同江以南的地区。唐朝与新罗维持了宗藩关系，但不再进行军事对抗。
statement.en:
Due to Silla's expansion and insufficient Tang forces, the Tang moved the Andong Protectorate from Pyongyang east to Liaodong (present-day Liaoyang), and later to Youzhou (Beijing). This marked the effective abandonment of direct Tang control over the northern Korean Peninsula. Silla effectively occupied the region south of the Daedong River. The Tang and Silla maintained a nominal suzerain-vassal relationship but no longer fought each other.

For Asia in 676 CE, “Tang moves the Andong Protectorate to Liaodong” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 日本制定《飞鸟净御原令》

summary.zh: 日本天武天皇（673-686年在位）开始编纂《飞鸟净御原令》（也称《天武律令》），这是日本第一部完整的律令法典，包括行政、刑事、民事等规范。虽然原文已散佚，但它为后来的《大宝律令》（701年）奠定了基础，推动了日本律令国家的建设。

title.zh: 李敬玄征吐蕃大败

summary.zh: 唐高宗任命李敬玄为洮河道大总管，率十八万唐军征讨吐蕃。李敬玄不懂军事，与吐蕃战于青海湖附近，大败而归，副将刘审礼被俘。唐军损失惨重，大将黑齿常之率数百精骑夜袭吐蕃军营，吐蕃才退兵。此战进一步削弱了唐朝在河陇地区的防守能力。

statement.zh: 唐高宗任命李敬玄为洮河道大总管，率十八万唐军征讨吐蕃。李敬玄不懂军事，与吐蕃战于青海湖附近，大败而归，副将刘审礼被俘。唐军损失惨重，大将黑齿常之率数百精骑夜袭吐蕃军营，吐蕃才退兵。此战进一步削弱了唐朝在河陇地区的防守能力。
statement.en:
Emperor Gaozong appointed Li Jingxuan as commander-in-chief of the Taohe route, leading 180,000 Tang troops to attack Tibet. Li Jingxuan, who knew nothing of military affairs, fought the Tibetans near Qinghai Lake and was utterly routed; his deputy Liu Shenli was captured. The Tang army suffered heavy losses. Only when the general Heichi Changzhi led a night raid on the Tibetan camp with a few hundred elite horsemen did the Tibetans withdraw. This defeat further weakened Tang defenses in the Hexi region.

For Asia in 678 CE, “Li Jingxuan's campaign against Tibet ends in disaster” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 王勃溺水身亡

summary.zh: 唐代著名诗人、“初唐四杰”之首的王勃前往交趾（今越南北部）探望父亲，渡海时不慎溺水，惊悸而死，年仅二十七岁。王勃代表作《滕王阁序》以“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”成为千古绝唱。他的早逝是唐代诗坛的巨大损失。

statement.zh: 唐代著名诗人、“初唐四杰”之首的王勃前往交趾（今越南北部）探望父亲，渡海时不慎溺水，惊悸而死，年仅27岁。王勃代表作《滕王阁序》以“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”成为千古绝唱。他的早逝是唐代诗坛的巨大损失。
statement.en:
Wang Bo, the leading poet of the 'Four Elites of the Early Tang', drowned in a storm while traveling to Jiaozhi (present-day northern Vietnam) to visit his father. He was only 27 years old. Wang Bo's masterpiece, 'A Tribute to the Tengwang Tower', with its famous line 'Falling glow flies together with the lonely duck; autumn waters share one color with the vast sky', has been celebrated through the ages. His early death was a great loss to Tang poetry.

For Asia in 679 CE, “Wang Bo drowns” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 伊斯兰什叶派正式成型

summary.zh: 阿里之子侯赛因（胡赛因）在库法起义反对倭马亚王朝，被倭马亚军队围困于卡尔巴拉（今伊拉克）。侯赛因及其七十二名追随者全部战死，侯赛因的头颅被送往大马士革。卡尔巴拉事件使什叶派与逊尼派彻底分裂，什叶派尊奉侯赛因为第三伊玛目，每年阿舒拉节纪念此事件。什叶派奠定了以伊玛目教义为核心的宗派特征。

statement.zh: 阿里之子侯赛因（胡赛因）在库法起义反对倭马亚王朝，被倭马亚军队围困于卡尔巴拉（今伊拉克）。侯赛因及其七十二名追随者全部战死，侯赛因的头颅被送往大马士革。卡尔巴拉事件使什叶派与逊尼派彻底分裂，什叶派尊奉侯赛因为第三伊玛目，每年阿舒拉节纪念此事件。什叶派奠定了以伊玛目教义为核心的宗派特征。
statement.en:
Husayn ibn Ali, the son of Ali, led a rebellion against the Umayyads and was surrounded by Umayyad forces at Karbala (in present-day Iraq). Husayn and his 72 followers were all killed, and Husayn's head was sent to Damascus. The Battle of Karbala caused a permanent split between Shia and Sunni Islam. The Shia venerate Husayn as the third imam and commemorate the event annually on the Day of Ashura. Shia identity was now fixed around the doctrine of the Imamate.

For Asia in 680 CE, “Shia Islam formally takes shape” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 卡尔巴拉战役

summary.zh: 倭马亚军队于卡尔巴拉击败先知家族，侯赛因殉难，成为什叶派哀悼与认同的核心。

title.zh: 突厥第二汗国（后突厥汗国）建立

summary.zh: 突厥酋长骨咄禄（颉跌利施可汗）在蒙古高原起兵，收复了被唐朝控制的铁勒诸部，重建突厥汗国，史称“后突厥汗国”或“突厥第二汗国”。骨咄禄定都于乌德鞬山（今蒙古杭爱山），多次侵扰唐朝北部边境。后突厥汗国持续了半个多世纪，直到744年被回纥所灭。

statement.en: A Turkic chieftain named Ilterish Qaghan (also known as Kutluk or Tonyukuk) rose in rebellion in the Mongolian plateau, recovering the Iron (Tiele) tribes previously under Tang control, and re-established the Turkic Khaganate, known as the 'Second Turkic Khaganate' or 'Göktürk Khaganate'.

statement.en: In 683 the Kök Türks revolted and the empire was reborn and reunified under Elterish (683–692); centered on Mongolia, it prospered under Kapghan (c. 692–716) and Bilge (716–734) before disintegrating soon afterward.

sources.locator: Section “Reunification”
sources.excerpt: In 683 the Kök Türks revolted. The Kök Türk empire was reborn and reunified under the khagan Elterish (683–692). Temporary setbacks notwithstanding, the Kök Türk empire was now centered on Mongolia, and it prospered under the rule of Kapghan (Mochuo; c. 692–716) and Bilge (Pijia; 716–734) but disintegrated soon afterward.

title.zh: 裴行俭再破突厥

summary.zh: 突厥余部阿史那伏念自立为可汗，与唐朝对抗。裴行俭再次率军征讨，用离间计使阿史那伏念内部分裂，伏念被部下擒献唐军。裴行俭将伏念处决，突厥叛乱彻底平定。此后唐朝北方边境维持了十余年的相对平静。

statement.zh: 突厥余部阿史那伏念自立为可汗，与唐朝对抗。裴行俭再次率军征讨，用离间计使阿史那伏念内部分裂，伏念被部下擒献唐军。裴行俭将伏念处决，突厥叛乱彻底平定。此后唐朝北方边境维持了十余年的相对平静。
statement.en:
The remaining Turkic rebel Ashina Fuzhi proclaimed himself khan and resisted the Tang. Pei Xingjian again led an expedition, using a strategy of sowing discord to split the rebels. Fuzhi was captured and handed over to the Tang. Pei executed Fuzhi, and the Turkic rebellion was completely crushed. Thereafter, the Tang's northern border enjoyed relative peace for about a decade.

For Asia in 681 CE, “Pei Xingjian again defeats the Turks” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 阿拉伯推行阿拉伯化政策

summary.zh: 倭马亚王朝在叙利亚、伊拉克、埃及等被征服地区强制推行阿拉伯语为行政和宗教语言，并鼓励阿拉伯人迁徙到新领土，与被征服民族融合。非阿拉伯穆斯林（马瓦里）被要求与阿拉伯人结盟，但仍受到歧视。这一政策加速了伊斯兰教的传播和阿拉伯文化的形成，但也引发了波斯等民族的强烈不满。

statement.zh: 倭马亚王朝在叙利亚、伊拉克、埃及等被征服地区强制推行阿拉伯语为行政和宗教语言，并鼓励阿拉伯人迁徙到新领土，与被征服民族融合。
statement.en: The Umayyad Caliphate enforced the use of Arabic as the official language of administration and religion in conquered territories such as Syria, Iraq, and Egypt, and encouraged Arabs to migrate to new territories and integrate with conquered peoples.

title.zh: 百济末代王子扶余隆病逝洛阳

summary.zh: 扶余隆是百济义慈王之子，660年百济亡国后随唐军北迁。664年唐高宗任其为熊津都督、封带方郡王，命与新罗文武王在就利山刑白马为盟，共安百济遗民。然新罗步步蚕食百济故地，扶余隆终不敢赴镇，长居洛阳，永淳元年病逝，年六十八，陪葬邙山。百济王室自此再无可资号召之人，遗民或北入唐土、或南融于新罗，复国之望彻底断绝。

title.zh: 玛雅亚斯奇兰城邦进入强盛期

summary.zh: 玛雅城邦亚斯奇兰（Yaxchilan，位于今墨西哥恰帕斯州）在国王伊察姆纳赫·巴拉姆二世（Itzamnaaj B'alam II）统治下走向鼎盛。他大兴土木，建造了多座金字塔和石碑，记录了自己的征战和祭祀活动。亚斯奇兰以其精美的石雕门楣和象形文字铭文闻名，是玛雅古典时期重要的政治和文化中心。

statement.en: The Maya city-state of Yaxchilan (in present-day Chiapas, Mexico) flourished under King Itzamnaaj B'alam II (also known as Shield Jaguar II).

title.zh: 武则天正式临朝称制

summary.zh: 中宗被废、睿宗即位后，武则天以太后身份临朝称制，掌握朝廷实权。睿宗李旦被软禁于别殿，不得干预政事。武则天改元文明，将东都洛阳改为神都，开始为称帝做全面准备。

statement.zh: 中宗被废、睿宗即位后，武则天以太后身份临朝称制，掌握朝廷实权。睿宗李旦被软禁于别殿，不得干预政事。武则天改元文明，将东都洛阳改为神都，开始为称帝做全面准备。
statement.en:
After Zhongzong was deposed and Ruizong installed, Wu Zetian, as empress dowager, held court and wielded actual power. Emperor Ruizong Li Dan was effectively confined in a side palace and not allowed to participate in government. Wu changed the era name to Wenming and renamed the eastern capital Luoyang as Shendu (Divine Capital). She began comprehensive preparations for declaring herself emperor.

For Asia in 683 CE, “Wu Zetian formally takes the throne as 'Empress Dowager' and holds court” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 希腊火在拜占庭广泛使用

summary.zh: 拜占庭帝国在多次海战中验证了希腊火的威力，开始在海军和城堡防御中普遍装备希腊火喷射器和手榴弹。希腊火秘方由国家严格保密，至今未完全复原。它在保卫君士坦丁堡、击败阿拉伯和俄罗斯人入侵中发挥了关键作用，是拜占庭千年国运的重要保障。

title.zh: 唐乾陵合葬

summary.zh: 唐高宗与武则天合葬乾陵，以梁山为陵、设无字碑与蕃臣像，是唐代帝陵制度与雌雄双阙的代表。

statement.zh:
唐高宗与武则天合葬乾陵，以梁山为陵，设无字碑与蕃臣像。合葬本身把两位统治者的政治关系延续到陵墓空间；以山为陵、双阙与蕃臣像的组合，则把陵墓设计成一套面向后世的权力表述。它因此被视为唐代帝陵制度与雌雄双阙的代表。

把「唐乾陵合葬」放回公元683年的唐，可以看到建筑变化的一个具体切面。

title.zh: 唐高宗驾崩，中宗即位

summary.zh: 唐高宗李治在东都洛阳贞观殿病逝，享年五十六岁。遗诏太子李显即位，是为唐中宗；若有军国大事不决，由天后武则天裁决。中宗即位后，欲以韦皇后之父韦玄贞为宰相，遭到裴炎反对。中宗怒道：“我以天下与韦玄贞何不可！”武则天以此为借口，废中宗为庐陵王，改立其弟李旦为帝，是为唐睿宗。

statement.zh: 唐高宗李治在东都洛阳贞观殿病逝，享年56岁。遗诏太子李显即位，是为唐中宗；若有军国大事不决，由天后武则天裁决。中宗即位后，欲以韦皇后之父韦玄贞为宰相，遭到裴炎反对。中宗怒道：“我以天下与韦玄贞何不可！”武则天以此为借口，废中宗为庐陵王，改立其弟李旦为帝，是为唐睿宗。
statement.en:
Emperor Gaozong of Tang died at the age of 56 in the Zhenguan Palace in Luoyang. His will made his son Li Xian emperor (as Emperor Zhongzong), with the provision that in case of urgent military and state affairs, Empress Dowager Wu Zetian would rule. After Zhongzong's accession, he wanted to appoint his father-in-law Wei Xuanzhen as chancellor, which was opposed by Pei Yan. Angrily, Zhongzong said, 'I could give the empire to Wei Xuanzhen, what would it matter?' Wu Zetian used this as a pretext to depose Zhongzong, reducing him to the title of Prince of Luling. She then installed another son, Li Dan, as emperor (Emperor Ruizong).

For Asia in 683 CE, “Emperor Gaozong dies; Emperor Zhongzong ascends the throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 徐敬业扬州起兵讨伐武则天

summary.zh: 李勣之孙徐敬业（后改姓李）因被贬官，与骆宾王、杜求仁等在扬州起兵，以匡复庐陵王李显为名，讨伐武则天。骆宾王撰写《讨武曌檄》，文采飞扬，传诵天下。武则天派李孝逸率三十万大军征讨，徐敬业兵败后被杀。此次起兵是武则天称帝前最大的反对势力，失败后武则天更加放心地推动改朝换代。

statement.zh: 李勣之孙徐敬业（后改姓李）因被贬官，与骆宾王、杜求仁等在扬州起兵，以匡复庐陵王李显为名，讨伐武则天。骆宾王撰写《讨武曌檄》，文采飞扬，传诵天下。武则天派李孝逸率三十万大军征讨，徐敬业兵败后被杀。此次起兵是武则天称帝前最大的反对势力，失败后武则天更加放心地推动改朝换代。
statement.en:
Xu Jingye (grandson of Li Ji, later renamed Li Jingye), incensed by his demotion, raised an army at Yangzhou with Luo Binwang and Du Qiuren, ostensibly to restore the deposed Prince of Luling Li Xian. Luo Binwang wrote the famous manifesto 'Opposing Wu Zhao's Imperial Usurpation', which was widely circulated for its literary flair. Wu Zetian sent Li Xiaoyi with 300,000 troops to suppress the rebellion. Xu Jingye was defeated and killed. This was the largest opposition to Wu before she declared herself emperor, and after its failure she was free to pursue her usurpation of the Tang throne.

For Asia in 684 CE, “Xu Jingye rebels against Wu Zetian at Yangzhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 来俊臣撰写《罗织经》

summary.zh: 武则天时期的酷吏来俊臣与党羽合编《罗织经》（全名《告密罗织经》），传授如何编造罪名、制造冤狱、刑讯逼供的权术。该书分十二卷，内容阴险毒辣。来俊臣凭借罗织手段残害了大量无辜官员和宗室，最终自己也因罪被武则天处死。

statement.zh: 武则天时期的酷吏来俊臣与党羽合编《罗织经》（全名《告密罗织经》），传授如何编造罪名、制造冤狱、刑讯逼供的权术。该书分十二卷，内容阴险毒辣。来俊臣凭借罗织手段残害了大量无辜官员和宗室，最终自己也因罪被武则天处死。
statement.en:
The harsh official Lai Junchen, together with his associates, compiled the 'Art of Framing' (also known as the 'Informers' Art'), a manual for fabricating charges, creating miscarriages of justice, and extracting confessions. The book had 12 volumes and was extremely cynical. Lai Junchen used his skills to persecute a large number of innocent officials and imperial relatives, but he was eventually executed by Wu Zetian for his crimes.

For Asia in 687 CE, “Lai Junchen compiles the 'Art of Framing'” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 李氏宗室起兵反武

summary.zh: 唐宗室诸王联合起兵反抗武则天，越王李贞在豫州（河南汝南）、琅琊王李冲在博州（山东聊城）同时举兵。但他们缺乏统一指挥，很快被武则天的军队镇压。武则天趁机大肆屠杀李唐宗室，韩王、鲁王、霍王等数十位亲王被杀，李唐宗室几乎被一网打尽。

statement.zh: 唐宗室诸王联合起兵反抗武则天，越王李贞在豫州（河南汝南）、琅琊王李冲在博州（山东聊城）同时举兵。但他们缺乏统一指挥，很快被武则天的军队镇压。武则天趁机大肆屠杀李唐宗室，韩王、鲁王、霍王等数十位亲王被杀，李唐宗室几乎被一网打尽。
statement.en:
Several Tang imperial princes rose in a coordinated rebellion against Wu Zetian. Prince Zhen of Yue (Li Zhen) raised troops in Yuzhou (modern Ruyang, Henan) and Prince Chong of Langya (Li Chong) in Bozhou (modern Liaocheng, Shandong) simultaneously. However, they lacked unified command, and were quickly crushed by Wu's forces. Taking advantage of the situation, Wu Zetian massacred the Li clan; dozens of princes, including the Prince of Han, Prince of Lu, and Prince of Huo, were killed, and the Tang imperial clan was almost annihilated.

For Asia in 688 CE, “The Li imperial clan rises against Wu Zetian” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 武则天改革官制，为称帝作准备

summary.zh: 武则天大规模改革官制，改中书省为凤阁，门下省为鸾台，尚书省为文昌台；改宰相为同凤阁鸾台三品。她还改革服色和官名，处处体现“革故鼎新”。同时，武则天开始制造“祥瑞”（如洛水出现宝图），并利用佛教《大云经》宣称自己是弥勒佛转世，为登基女皇大造舆论。

statement.zh: 武则天大规模改革官制，改中书省为凤阁，门下省为鸾台，尚书省为文昌台；改宰相为同凤阁鸾台三品。她还改革服色和官名，处处体现“革故鼎新”。同时，武则天开始制造“祥瑞”（如洛水出现宝图），并利用佛教《大云经》宣称自己是弥勒佛转世，为登基女皇大造舆论。
statement.en:
Wu Zetian carried out extensive reforms of the official system, renaming the Chancellery as Phoenix Hall, the Gate Department as Swan Court, and the Secretariat as the Ministry for the Advancement of the State. She also changed the names of ministers and officials. She changed the colors of official robes and reformulated official titles, in every way signaling 'reform and renewal'. At the same time, Wu Zetian began to create 'auspicious omens' (such as the discovery of a chart in the Luo River) and used the Buddhist 'Great Cloud Sutra' to proclaim that she was the reincarnation of Maitreya Buddha, preparing public opinion for her ascension as empress regnant.

For Asia in 689 CE, “Wu Zetian reforms the official system to prepare for her accession” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 耶路撒冷建岩顶圆顶寺

summary.zh: 倭马亚哈里发在圣殿山建岩顶圆顶寺，金顶覆盖“圣石”，是伊斯兰早期最宏伟的圣殿建筑。

statement.zh:
倭马亚哈里发在圣殿山建岩顶圆顶寺，金顶覆盖“圣石”，是伊斯兰早期最宏伟的圣殿建筑。建筑以八角形基座与圆顶组织空间，内外以马赛克与书法装饰，把圣地记忆与王朝权威结合；选址与犹太圣殿传统相叠。它成为伊斯兰建筑的重要范本。

把「耶路撒冷建岩顶圆顶寺」放回公元691年的倭马亚，可以看到建筑变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Umayyad caliph raised the Dome of the Rock on the Temple Mount, its golden dome over the 'Foundation Stone', the grandest early-Islamic shrine.

title.zh: 武则天迁都洛阳

summary.zh: 武则天正式将政治中心从长安迁往洛阳，改洛阳为神都。她以洛阳为武周首都，长安为陪都。洛阳地处中原，交通便利，且远离关陇旧贵族势力。武则天在洛阳大兴土木，修建天堂、明堂、天津桥等宏伟建筑，使洛阳成为当时世界上最繁华的城市之一。

statement.zh: 武则天正式将政治中心从长安迁往洛阳，改洛阳为神都。
statement.en: Wu Zetian formally moved the political center from Chang'an to Luoyang, renaming it the Divine Capital (Shendu).

sources.locator: Article body, sections on the Luoyang residence and the 690–705 reign
sources.excerpt: She took up residence in Luoyang (the eastern capital) and ruthlessly aggrandized her role by inflating the bureaucracy during Gaozong’s illness. ... Six years later, in 690, at age 65, the empress usurped the throne itself. ... In February 705 a conspiracy formed among the leading ministers and generals, who seized the palace, executed the Zhang brothers, and compelled the empress, old and ill, to yield power to Zhongzong, who reigned until 710. She retired to another palace and died there in December of that year.

title.zh: 拜占庭查士丁尼二世复位

title.zh: 武则天禁屠与佛教鼎盛

title.zh: 摩尼教传入中国

title.zh: 契丹李尽忠反周

summary.zh: 契丹部落首领李尽忠（曾赐姓李）因武周官员赵文翙欺凌契丹人，联合孙万荣起兵反周，攻陷营州（今辽宁朝阳）。李尽忠自称“无上可汗”，武则天派曹仁师、张玄遇等率军征讨，在黄獐谷全军覆没。后来突厥趁机袭击契丹后方，李尽忠战死，孙万荣逃奔突厥被杀。这次反叛沉重打击了武周在东北的统治。

statement.zh: 契丹部落首领李尽忠（曾赐姓李）因武周官员赵文翙欺凌契丹人，联合孙万荣起兵反周，攻陷营州（今辽宁朝阳）。李尽忠自称“无上可汗”，武则天派曹仁师、张玄遇等率军征讨，在黄獐谷全军覆没。后来突厥趁机袭击契丹后方，李尽忠战死，孙万荣逃奔突厥被杀。这次反叛沉重打击了武周在东北的统治。
statement.en:
The Khitan tribal chief Li Jinzhong (the Li surname was a Tang honorific), angered by mistreatment by the Wu Zhou official Zhao Wenju, joined with Sun Wanrong to rise in rebellion, capturing Yingzhou (present-day Chaoyang, Liaoning). Li Jinzhong declared himself 'Wushang Khan'. Wu Zetian sent generals Cao Renshi and Zhang Xuanyu to suppress the rebellion, but they were annihilated at the Huangzhong Valley. Later, the Turks raided the Khitan rear, Li Jinzhong was killed, and Sun Wanrong fled to the Turks and was killed. This rebellion severely damaged Wu Zhou's control over the northeast.

For Asia in 696 CE, “Khitan chief Li Jinzhong rebels against Wu Zhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 武则天诛杀来俊臣

summary.zh: 酷吏来俊臣欲陷害武氏诸王和太平公主，诬告他们谋反。武氏诸王和太平公主联合反击，将来俊臣的罪行揭发。武则天下令将来俊臣处斩。来俊臣之死标志着武则天酷吏政治阶段的结束，朝野人心稍安。

statement.zh: 酷吏来俊臣欲陷害武氏诸王和太平公主，诬告他们谋反。武氏诸王和太平公主联合反击，将来俊臣的罪行揭发。武则天下令将来俊臣处斩。来俊臣之死标志着武则天酷吏政治阶段的结束，朝野人心稍安。
statement.en:
The harsh official Lai Junchen planned to accuse the Wu princes and Princess Taiping of rebellion, but they united to expose his crimes. Wu Zetian ordered Lai Junchen executed. The death of Lai Junchen marked the end of the stage of 'cruel official rule' under Wu Zetian, bringing some relief to the court.

For Asia in 697 CE, “Wu Zetian executes Lai Junchen” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 日本开始编纂《大宝律令》

summary.zh: 日本文武天皇在大臣藤原不比等的主持下，颁布《大宝律令》（大宝是年号）。该律令包括刑法（律）和行政法（令），以唐朝《永徽律》为蓝本，结合日本国情修改。《大宝律令》完善了二官八省的中央官制，将全国划分为六十六国，实行班田收授法和户籍制度。它是日本正式确立律令国家的标志，影响持续数百年。

statement.zh: 日这一事件武天皇在大臣藤原不比等的主持下，颁布《大宝律令》（大宝是年号）。
statement.en: Emperor Monmu of Japan, under the leadership of Chancellor Fujiwara no Fuhito, promulgated the 'Taihō Code' (the era name was Taihō).

en: Emperor Monmu of Japan, under the leadership of Chancellor Fujiwara no Fuhito, promulgated the 'Taihō Code' (the era name was Taihō).

title.zh: 狄仁杰去世

summary.zh: 武周名相狄仁杰病逝，享年七十一岁。武则天沉痛地说：“朝堂空矣！”追赠文昌右相，谥号文惠。狄仁杰以刚正敢谏著称，多次劝阻武则天滥杀和穷兵黩武，并设法保护李唐宗室。他秘密向武则天推荐了张柬之等大臣，为后来神龙政变恢复唐朝做了铺垫。

statement.zh: 武周名相狄仁杰病逝，享年71岁。武则天沉痛地说：“朝堂空矣！”追赠文昌右相，谥号文惠。狄仁杰以刚正敢谏著称，多次劝阻武则天滥杀和穷兵黩武，并设法保护李唐宗室。他秘密向武则天推荐了张柬之等大臣，为后来神龙政变恢复唐朝做了铺垫。
statement.en:
The renowned chancellor Di Renjie of the Wu Zhou died of illness at the age of 71. Wu Zetian said mournfully, 'The court is empty now.' She posthumously honored him as Minister of Education (Wenchang Youxiang) with the posthumous name Wenhui. Di Renjie was known for his uprightness and forthright remonstrations, often dissuading Wu Zetian from excessive killing and military adventures, and protecting the Li imperial clan. He secretly recommended officials such as Zhang Jianzhi to Wu, which paved the way for the Shenlong Coup that restored the Tang dynasty.

For Asia in 700 CE, “Di Renjie dies” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 唐三彩风行

summary.zh: 唐三彩以白色黏土成型，施含铅低温釉，用铜、铁、钴等着色剂在约800℃二次烧成，黄、绿、褐、蓝诸色交融流淌。品类以马、骆驼、胡人俑与镇墓兽最著，多出于长安、洛阳的盛唐墓葬，兼具随葬明器与外销商品的双重身份。

statement.zh: 唐三彩以白色黏土成型，施含铅低温釉，用铜、铁、钴等着色剂在约800℃二次烧成，黄、绿、褐、蓝诸色交融流淌。
statement.en: Sancai wares were shaped from white clay, coated with a lead-based low-fired glaze coloured by copper, iron and cobalt, and fired a second time at about 800C so that amber, green, brown and blue ran together.

title.zh: 唐代绞缬（扎染）盛行

summary.zh: 绞缬即以线缝扎、打结或夹压织物局部使其防染，入染后拆线，花纹边缘晕散柔和。唐代绞缬与蜡缬、夹缬并称“三缬”，纹样有鹿胎、鱼子、玛瑙等名目，上自宫廷服饰下至民间衣被皆用之，实物见于新疆吐鲁番墓葬与日本正仓院。

statement.zh: 绞缬即以线缝扎、打结或夹压织物局部使其防染，入染后拆线，花纹边缘晕散柔和。唐代绞缬与蜡缬、夹缬并称“三缬”，纹样有鹿胎、鱼子、玛瑙等名目，上自宫廷服饰下至民间衣被皆用之，实物见于新疆吐鲁番墓葬与日本正仓院。
statement.en:
In jiaoxie, cloth was stitched, knotted or clamped so that the bound areas resisted the dye; when the threads were released, soft haloed patterns emerged. Tang jiaoxie ranked with wax-resist and clamp-resist dyeing as the 'three resists', with patterns named after fawn skin, fish roe and agate. Used for court robes and ordinary clothing alike, surviving examples come from tombs at Turpan in Xinjiang and the Shosoin repository in Japan.

For Asia in 700 CE, “Tiedye (jiaoxie) flourishes in Tang” is a traceable node of Craft change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 唐代螺钿镶嵌工艺精进

summary.zh: 螺钿以夜光螺、鲍鱼贝等磨制薄片，切成花鸟人物纹样，嵌入漆器、木器与铜镜背面，再经打磨推光使之与漆面齐平。唐代螺钿多在黑漆或银背地上镶嵌，兼施宝石与金银平脱，富丽夺目；日本正仓院所藏螺钿紫檀五弦琵琶即其代表。

statement.zh: 螺钿以夜光螺、鲍鱼贝等磨制薄片，切成花鸟人物纹样，嵌入漆器、木器与铜镜背面，再经打磨推光使之与漆面齐平。唐代螺钿多在黑漆或银背地上镶嵌，兼施宝石与金银平脱，富丽夺目；日本正仓院所藏螺钿紫檀五弦琵琶即其代表。
statement.en:
In luodian, iridescent shells such as turban and abalone were ground into thin sheets, cut into birds, flowers and figures, inlaid into lacquer, wood or the backs of bronze mirrors, then polished flush with the surface. Tang craftsmen set the shell against black lacquer or silver grounds, often adding gems and gold-and-silver appliqué. The Shosoin in Japan preserves a Tang five-stringed rosewood lute inlaid in exactly this way.

For Asia in 700 CE, “Tang mother-of-pearl (luodian) inlay peaks” is a traceable node of Craft change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 神秀北宗渐修禅

summary.zh: 禅僧神秀在北方倡'时时勤拂拭'的渐修法门，与慧能南宗顿悟并立，为禅宗重要一支。

statement.zh: 禅僧神秀在北方倡“时时勤拂拭”的渐修法门，与慧能南宗顿悟并立，为禅宗重要一支。渐修强调持续观照与逐步清净，把修行看作日常的、可积累的过程；北宗因此重视坐禅、戒律与经教的次第，得到两京王室与士人的支持。南宗以顿悟立宗，两派在后来的法统叙述中被反复讨论，形成禅宗内部最重要的分野之一。
statement.en: Chan master Shenxiu in the north teaches gradual cultivation, 'ever wipe the mirror bright', standing beside Huineng's sudden enlightenment as a major Chan school.

title.zh: 基督教在日耳曼地区传播

summary.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊传教士威利布罗德（Willibrord）在法兰克王国宫相丕平二世的支持下，前往弗里西亚（今荷兰）和日耳曼地区传教。他建立乌得勒支主教区，使许多日耳曼部落改信基督教。这是基督教向欧洲北部和东部传播的重要一步。

title.zh: 北美普韦布洛文化建造崖居

summary.zh: 约公元700-1300年，北美西南部的阿纳萨齐人（Anasazi，后称普韦布洛祖先/Ancestral Pueblo）在悬崖峭壁上建造了多层石头村落（崖居），如梅萨维德（Mesa Verde）和查科峡谷（Chaco Canyon）。查科峡谷建造了12座大型"大屋"（great houses），最大的普韦布洛·博尼托有600多个房间。这些建筑精确对准太阳和月亮

statement.zh: 约公元700-1300年，北美西南部的阿纳萨齐人（Anasazi，后称普韦布洛祖先/Ancestral Pueblo）在悬崖峭壁上建造了多层石头村落（崖居），如梅萨维德（Mesa Verde）和查科峡谷（Chaco Canyon）。
statement.en: Around 700–1300 AD, the Ancestral Puebloans (also known as Anasazi) in the southwestern United States built multi-story stone villages in cliffs, such as at Mesa Verde and Chaco Canyon.

zh: 约公元700-1300年，北美西南部的阿纳萨齐人（Anasazi，后称普韦布洛祖先/Ancestral Pueblo）在悬崖峭壁上建造了多层石头村落（崖居），如梅萨维德（Mesa Verde）和查科峡谷（Chaco Canyon）。
en: Around 700–1300 AD, the Ancestral Puebloans (also known as Anasazi) in the southwestern United States built multi-story stone villages in cliffs, such as at Mesa Verde and Chaco Canyon.

title.zh: 复活节岛最早波利尼西亚定居者到达

summary.zh: 约公元700-900年，波利尼西亚航海者乘坐双体独木舟抵达复活节岛（Rapa Nui，今智利），这是地球上最偏远的有人居住岛屿之一。岛民在几个世纪内建造了约900尊摩艾石像（moai），最高达10米重82吨。摩艾代表了部落祖先的灵体，竖立在名为ahu的石台上。森林砍伐和资源过度利用导致了社会崩溃和内战，欧洲人到达时岛上人口已大幅减少。

statement.en: Around 700–900 AD, Polynesian navigators arrived on Easter Island (Rapa Nui) in double-hulled canoes, one of the most remote inhabited islands on Earth.
